$comment: Master timeline for the meme. Times are seconds in media/source.mp4 (29.97 fps); subtract window.start for meme time. Original lines are referenced by id + paraphrased gist only; Whisper's transcript stays in /transcript. origSyl and onsets come from scripts/prep.py (Whisper large-v3-turbo word timestamps on the vocal stem); DI barks (D02-D07, R01, F01) are timed from the vocal-stem energy envelope.

source.title: This Is My Rifle Scene Full Metal Jacket PG Version
